question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Outstanding
solution:
The correct answer is -** Ordinary.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate antonym of "outstanding" is "ordinary.
 
• "Outstanding" means **exceptional, excellent, or remarkable**. The opposite or antonym of "outstanding" would be a word that means average, ordinary, or unremarkable.
 
• "**Astounding**" means surprising or shocking, which is not the opposite of outstanding.
 
• "**Ordinary**" means plain, average, or usual, which is the most appropriate antonym of outstanding.
 
• "**Remarkable**" is a synonym of outstanding, not its antonym.
 
• "**Honest**" means truthful or sincere, which is not related to the meaning of outstanding.

 

 
• Therefore, option 2) **Ordinary **is the correct antonym of the given word "outstanding."
